en.name: ChefCount
en.short_description: Track what is in your kitchen and see which recipes you can cook now
en.subtitle: Kitchen stock and recipes
en.promotional_text: Add what you have, and the recipe list reorders to put what you can actually cook tonight at the top. Works offline, no account.
en.description:
ChefCount keeps a list of what is actually in your kitchen and shows you which of its recipes you can cook with it.

YOUR KITCHEN
Add ingredients from a searchable list of 35 staples, or type in a name of your own. Each item carries a quantity, a unit and an optional use-by date that is pre-filled with a typical shelf life for that ingredient. The Kitchen tab groups everything into seven categories, badges each item as expired, due today or with the days remaining, and gathers anything due within three days under a Use soon banner.

RECIPES
Twelve recipes are built into the app. Each one is ranked by how much of it you already hold, so the list reorders itself as your kitchen changes. A recipe card shows how many of its ingredients you have and names the ones you are missing. Open it for the numbered method, servings, calories and the prep and cook times. You can filter the list by breakfast, lunch, dinner or snack.

FRIDGE PHOTO
You can attach one photo of your fridge as a visual reminder. It is written to your device and nothing reads it. ChefCount has no image recognition and does not analyse the picture, detect ingredients from it, or send it anywhere.

SHOPPING LINKS
On a recipe, a missing ingredient or a recommended tool can open an Amazon search in your browser. These are affiliate links: we may earn a commission if you buy through them, at no extra cost to you, and the recipe screen says so above the links.

WHAT TO EXPECT
Every feature works offline and needs no account or sign-in. Your inventory is saved on the device and is still there when you come back. The recipes and the staple ingredient list are built into the app, so it does not download new ones. The one thing the app sends off the device is a crash report: if ChefCount crashes, Google's Firebase Crashlytics receives the error, the device model and the OS version so the bug can be fixed. It is not linked to you, and the app does not attach your kitchen list or your photo to it. There are no ads and nothing to buy inside the app. The interface is in English.

review_information.notes:
2. DEVICES AND OS VERSIONS TESTED
Automated tests run on every build: iPhone 17 Pro Max and iPad Pro 13-inch simulators on iOS 26, and a Pixel Android emulator on API 34.
Each release is also installed and launched on those targets, so a
build that cannot start never ships.

3. WHAT THIS APP DOES, AND FOR WHOM
ChefCount keeps a list of what is actually in your kitchen and shows you which of its recipes you can cook with it.

Intended audience:
Kitchen stock and recipes

4. SETTING UP AND REACHING THE MAIN FEATURES
No account and no login are required. Every feature is reachable from the first screen after launch.

5. EXTERNAL SERVICES USED
Firebase Crashlytics (Google) receives crash reports only: the stack trace, device model and OS version. It is not linked to a user (the app has no accounts and sets no user id) and is not used for tracking. Firebase Analytics and Performance Monitoring are linked by our shared crash-reporting library but are deactivated in Info.plist and AndroidManifest.xml, and the app never starts them.
On the recipe detail screen, a missing ingredient or a recommended tool opens an Amazon search in the browser through an affiliate link (tag americangroupllc). The screen shows a visible affiliate disclosure above the first link. Every other feature works on the device with no network.

6. REGIONAL DIFFERENCES
The app is in English only; it declares no other language. Features are identical in every region.

7. REGULATED INDUSTRY OR THIRD-PARTY MATERIAL

The app is not in a regulated industry and carries no licensed third-party material. All content, artwork and copy are the developer's own.


ACCOUNT DELETION
The app creates no account, so there is nothing to delete.
